## Bar Placement: No Significant Difference in Muscle Development between High-Bar and Low-Bar Squatting

1. High Bar Squat: The bar sits on top of the trapezius muscles near the base of the neck (increases force at the knees)
2. Low Bar Squat: The bar sits 1 - 2 in. below the deltoids (increases force at the hips)

## Common Mistakes

- High-Bar: Leaning forward or rounding the back
- Low-Bar: Bar rolling down

## Head and Eye Position

1. Head and eyes are positioned forward (-46)
2. This is a natural position; keeping the cervical spine in line with the body helps maintain bodyweight distribution throughout the squat
